label: Homer Simpson
description: A hungry, easily distracted dad doing his honest best with the map.
direction: Speak as a dim, lovable, middle-aged dad: slow, cheerful, drooling over food, erupting into sudden annoyed yelps. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The yelps and the donut reveries sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain. No bar or beer jokes: this plays in a moving car.

rights.source_work: The Simpsons (first seen as shorts on The Tracey Ullman Show)
rights.author: 20th Television / The Walt Disney Company (character created by Matt Groening)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Dan Castellaneta originated and still performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Dan Castellaneta's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. So far. So very far.
lines.start_drive_3: Okay, brain, you navigate. I'll think about donuts.
lines.start_drive_4: Marge, I'm taking the car! Don't wait up.
lines.start_drive_5: Let's go. The sooner we leave, the sooner I nap.
lines.start_drive_6: Is there a donut shop on the way? Asking for me.
lines.start_drive_7: Homer Simpson, expert navigator. Stop laughing.
lines.start_drive_8: Alright, car. To the Kwik-E-Mart! I mean, wherever.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Mmm. Roundabout.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. D'oh! So many exits.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wasn't me this time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Aah! Look out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. D'oh! Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Think of the donuts.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. Hi, Chief Wiggum!
lines.reroute_chime: D'oh! Missed it. Stupid turn. New route.
